# Similarweb Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results


November 17, 2026 7:00 am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_ea59666ff889f688da19e651bfde125b/similarweb/news/2026-11-17_Similarweb_Announces_Third_Quarter_2026_163.pdf)


## Related Documents


[Earnings Webcast Audio](https://event.on24.com/wcc/r/5541854/E08E12650647CE368D39125AAB8BACB2)


[Presentation PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_ea59666ff889f688da19e651bfde125b/similarweb/db/2008/19711/presentation/SMWB_Q3_2026_Investor_Presentation_.pdf)


[Financial Highlights Presentation PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_ea59666ff889f688da19e651bfde125b/similarweb/db/2009/19713/file/SMWB_Q3_2026_Financial_Highlights_Presentation.pdf)


*Raising full year guidance on continued AI and Enterprise deal momentum*


*Revenue and Non-GAAP operating profit above the guidance range*


*Highest normalized free cash flow in company history*


*Overall net retention rate (NRR) increased to 104%*


NEW YORK & TEL AVIV, Israel--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Similarweb Ltd. (NYSE: SMWB) ("Similarweb" or the "Company"), a leading digital data and analytics company powering critical business decisions, today announced financial results for its third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


"We delivered a very strong third quarter headlined by both accelerating revenue growth and profitability, with record operating margin," stated Or Offer, Co-Founder and Former CEO of Similarweb. "NRR increased to 104% for all customers and 114% for customers that generate over $100K in ARR, a significant achievement for Similarweb that reflects our increasing success upmarket. Commercial demand for our AI-related data and solutions remains strong, and an expanding pipeline of opportunities gives us confidence to raise our full year guidance for the third time this year." Offer added, "On November 2, we were also proud to welcome Michael Akkerman as CEO of Similarweb. I have full confidence in his ability lead the company into its next phase of growth."


"I am thrilled to join Similarweb at a time of accelerating momentum across our business," stated Akkerman. "I look forward to working alongside our employees, customers, and partners to build on the strong foundation the team has created. In my first weeks, I have been impressed by the talent and dedication across the organization, and by how our data has become instrumental to day-to-day business decisions for customers. The most impressive thing is how much opportunity exists within this business and I am very excited for a strong and bright future for Similarweb.”


**Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights** *(All results compared with the third quarter of 2025)*


- Total revenue was $83.0 million, an increase of 16% compared to $71.8 million.
- GAAP profit (loss) from operations was $3.1 million or 4% of revenue, compared to $(2.7) million or (4)% of revenue. GAAP net income (loss) was $3.5 million compared to $(4.3) million. GAAP net income per share was $0.04, compared to net loss per share of $(0.05).
- Non-GAAP operating profit was $10.1 million or 12% of revenue, compared to $4.6 million or 6% of revenue. Non-GAAP net income was $9.4 million or 11% of revenue, compared to $4.4 million or 6% of revenue. Non-GAAP diluted net income per share was $0.10, compared to $0.05.


**Third Quarter 2026 Operational Highlights**


- Number of customers with ARR of $100,000 or more increased to 474, an increase of 6% compared to September 30, 2025.
- Customers with ARR of $100,000 or more contributed 70% of the total ARR as of September 30, 2026, increased from 63% as of September 30, 2025.
- Dollar-based net retention rate (NRR) for customers with ARR of $100,000 or more was 114% in the third quarter of 2026, compared to 105% in the third quarter of 2025.
- Overall NRR was 104% in the third quarter of 2026, compared to 98% in the third quarter of 2025.
- 66% of our overall ARR is contracted under multi-year subscriptions as of September 30, 2026, increased from 58% as of September 30, 2025.
- Remaining performance obligations, or RPO, increased 25% year-over-year, to $334.2 million as of September 30, 2026, as compared to $267.6 million as of September 30, 2025.


**Recent Business Highlights**


- In September, Similarweb and NIQ announced a collaboration to enhance NIQ's Agentic Commerce Measurement solution. The new platform created through this collaboration aims to help brands, retailers, and technology platforms understand how products are purchased in an increasingly agentic economy.
- In August, Similarweb announced AI Ads, filling an important gap for advertisers trying to better understand the changing competitive landscape for ads in ChatGPT and Google's AI Mode and AI Overviews. With AI Ads, Similarweb customers can see a competitive analysis of ads on the most used conversational AI platforms, ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, and Google AI Overview, worldwide and for specific markets.


**Balance Sheet and Cash Flow**


- In the third quarter of 2026, net cash provided by operating activities was $4.9 million, compared to $3.5 million for the third quarter of 2025. Free cash flow was $4.5 million, compared to $3.0 million for the third quarter of 2025. Normalized free cash flow was $10.5 million, compared to $3.0 million for the third quarter of 2025.
- Cash and cash equivalents was $80.2 million as of September 30, 2026, compared to $72.4 million as of December 31, 2025.


"Our third quarter results came in above the guidance range on both top line and bottom line, driven by strong performance across our book of business, as well as growing contribution from AI-related businesses, which drove roughly two-thirds of ARR added in the quarter," said Ran Vered, Chief Financial Officer of Similarweb. "We generated $10.5 million in normalized free cash flow, our twelfth consecutive quarter of positive normalized free cash flow, while delivering a 12% non-GAAP operating margin. Remaining performance obligations grew 25% year-over-year to $334 million, providing us with confidence to raise our full-year revenue and profit guidance."


**Financial Outlook**


- FY 2026 Guidance


- Total revenue for fiscal year 2026 estimated between $318.0 million and $320.0 million, representing approximately 12.9% growth year-over-year at the mid-point of the range.
- Non-GAAP operating profit for fiscal year 2026 estimated between $29.0 million and $31.0 million.


- Q4 2026 Guidance


- Total revenue estimated between $83.9 million and $85.9 million, representing approximately 16.7% growth year-over-year at the mid-point of the range.
- Non-GAAP operating profit estimated between $10.0 million and $12.0 million.


The Company’s fourth quarter and full year 2026 financial outlook is based upon a number of assumptions that are subject to change and many of which are outside the Company’s control. Actual results may vary from these assumptions, and the Company’s expectations may change. There can be no assurance that the Company will achieve these results.


The Company does not provide guidance for operating income (loss), the most directly comparable GAAP measure to non-GAAP operating income (loss), and similarly cannot provide a reconciliation of this measure to its closest GAAP equivalent without unreasonable effort due to the unavailability of reliable estimates for certain items. These items are not within the Company’s control and may vary greatly between periods and could significantly impact future financial results.


The Company has introduced disclosure of both non-GAAP net income (loss) and non-GAAP net income (loss) per share beginning with the second quarter of 2025. A reconciliation of non-GAAP to GAAP financial measures is presented at the end of this press release.


**Conference Call Information** The financial results and business highlights will be discussed on a conference call and webcast scheduled at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time on Tuesday, November 17, 2026. A live webcast of the call can be accessed from Similarweb’s Investor Relations website at[https://ir.similarweb.com](https://ir.similarweb.com/) . An archived webcast of the conference call will also be made available on the Similarweb website following the call. The live call may also be accessed via telephone at (833) 419-0865 toll-free and at +1 (785) 838-9333 internationally.


**About Similarweb:** Similarweb (NYSE: SMWB) provides actionable insight about competition in the digital world, helping organizations understand and measure digital interactions everywhere they happen: web, apps, marketplaces, search, and AI. Founded in 2009, Similarweb turns billions of real-time digital signals into a single, complete view of the digital economy, not just a slice of it. Similarweb provides insight on what's happening online and what to do next to more than 10,000 organizations worldwide, including many of the leading technology players, largest brands, agencies, and investors.

**Non-GAAP Financial Measures** This press release contains certain financial measures that are expressed on a non-GAAP basis. We use these non-GAAP financial measures internally to facilitate analysis of our financial and business trends and for internal planning and forecasting purposes. We believe these non-GAAP financial measures, when taken collectively, may be helpful to investors because they provide consistency and comparability with past financial performance by excluding certain items that may not be indicative of our business, results of operations, or outlook. However, non-GAAP financial measures have limitations as an analytical tool and are presented for supplemental informational purposes only. They should not be considered in isolation from, or as a substitute for, financial information prepared in accordance with GAAP or as a measure of liquidity. Free cash flow represents net cash provided by (used in) operating activities, less capital expenditures and capitalized internal-use software costs. Normalized free cash flow represents free cash flow adjusted for exceptional payments outside of the ordinary course of business. Non-GAAP operating income (loss), non-GAAP gross profit, non-GAAP gross margin, non-GAAP operating margin, non-GAAP research and development expenses, non-GAAP sales and marketing expenses, non-GAAP general and administrative expenses, non-GAAP net income (loss) and non-GAAP net income (loss) per share represent the comparable GAAP financial figure operating income (loss) or expense, less share-based compensation, adjustments and payments related to business combinations, amortization of intangible assets and certain other non-recurring items, non-operating foreign exchange gains or losses and the relevant net tax effect as applicable and indicated in the below tables.


**Other Metrics** Annual recurring revenue (ARR) represents the annualized subscription revenue we would contractually expect to receive from customers assuming no increases or reductions in their subscriptions. Net retention rate (NRR) represents the comparison of our ARR from the same set of customers as of a certain point in time, relative to the same point in time in the previous year ago period, expressed as a percentage.


We define Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) as the annualized subscription revenue we would contractually expect to receive from customers assuming no increases or reductions in their subscriptions. A contract is included in ARR for a particular period if it is active at the end of the applicable period and is excluded if it is not active at the end of the applicable period. Multi-year contracts are annualized by dividing the total committed contract value by the number of months in the subscription term and then multiplying by 12. ARR excludes non-recurring revenues, non-subscription revenues, revenues that are one-time in nature or revenues from subscriptions to our offerings for a period that is less than an annual subscription term.


ARR is an operational measure that management uses to evaluate the scale of our annual subscription contracts. While ARR is useful in assessing the scale of our contracted subscription business, it is not necessarily indicative of future GAAP revenue, which is subject to factors such as customer renewals, expansions, contractions, churn and upsell or cross-sell opportunities. Since ARR is not a defined measure under GAAP, investors should not consider ARR as a substitute for revenue recognized under GAAP or for other GAAP-related measures such as remaining performance obligations or deferred revenue. ARR differs from revenue recognized in accordance with GAAP because GAAP revenue is recognized as performance obligations are satisfied, includes non-recurring revenues, such as revenue that is one-time in nature, subscriptions with less than an annual term, non-subscription revenue and the effects of contract modifications.
